primary: Mean candidate score versus 81k, with both seat assignments clustered per independent schedule.
criterion: Add 243k tier only if the two-sided 95% pair-cluster bootstrap lower bound exceeds 0.5. Otherwise evidence insufficient; keep two tiers. No outcome-dependent stopping or extra samples.
selection: Identical 243k selection on both arms, live blind policy. Native iteration-only experiment; baked production selection and human win rate are not directly estimated.
